sourceDecisionQuestions.question: Spanish gotera is a roof leak or drip; archived French la fuite is broader. Confirm the roofing dictionary sense before selecting a scored face.

The source orders covering an unfinished section in this windy 4:00 scene. The archived French paraphrases tarp as protect with a tarp and could read as universal high-wind work instruction. Keep the scene-specific source meaning and approved site-weather/fall-protection decision distinct before scoring.

Source amarren/tie down the tarp with rope implies securing by tying. Archived fixez bien is broader; select a French form that preserves rope tie-down semantics after qualified trade and safety review.
Open deck names the exposed structural roof deck. Archived support de couverture exposé may denote a broader substrate; align with Core 1/7 deck terminology.
Tonight may include overnight rain; archived ce soir can mean this evening. Check source time scope and a natural French forecast expression together.

Source speaking asks which section needs a tarp and for the crew to repeat the plan. Archived speaking adds consultation about weather and working at height. Keep that domain-review note separate from the source learner objective until the approved plan is established.
